correctness.rationale: The substitution t_{2k}=t_k, t_{2k+1}=1-t_k proves S_{2k}=k and S_{2k+1}=k+t_k. The continuous 2^{s+1}-odometer-address transfers u_s and u_m satisfy y_0=Δu_s mod 2^s and y_0=d+Δu_m mod m on the aligned dense orbit and hence throughout Y; Chinese remaindering gives the explicit conjugacy. The decorated primitive substitution Ψ(a,r)=((a,2r),(1-a,2r+1)) for odd m has all 2m letters in sufficiently high substituted blocks: disjoint binary one-bit parity-flip witnesses in each residue modulo odd m prove both symbols occur, and invertibility of 2^k transports all factors through residues. This proves strict ergodicity of each slice. Separate even/odd prefix counts and conditional digit fairness give density 1/q even for nonminimal q. Independently recomputed 64000 finite transfer/prefix identities; infinite assertions rest on substitution and odometer arguments, not enumeration.
